🍚 RICE + BABY OIL “COLLAGEN CREAM”—SKIN REPAIR OR VIRAL MYTH?

Rice-based skincare may temporarily make the skin feel softer, while baby oil helps seal in moisture. However, this homemade mixture does not contain collagen, stimulate collagen production or erase wrinkles—even with nightly use.

A safer option:

• Cleanse your face gently
• Apply a fragrance-free moisturizer to slightly damp skin
• If your skin is very dry, press 1–2 drops of plain mineral oil over the moisturizer
• Use only on dry areas, preferably at night
• Wash your face normally in the morning

⚠️ Homemade rice creams can become contaminated quickly, especially when water is added. Avoid storing or repeatedly using them. Baby oil may also feel too heavy for oily or acne-prone skin.

For improving fine lines, daily sunscreen and evidence-based ingredients such as retinoids are more reliable options.
